turn1.explanation: The unit responds most strongly to cheese, including the word itself, plural forms, and the names of specific cheeses such as mozzarella and Brie (it even fires on Brie the actress's name). Separately, it responds at moderate strength to C/C++ preprocessor directives (#define, #include).
turn1.evidence: All 12 top examples are cheese tokens (or 'Brie' as a name) across food, news and recipe contexts. Every mid-range example is the '#' and 'define'/'include' tokens in C/C++ code, which have no semantic connection to cheese.
